steps.code:
# Get content for all notes and extract ate_homemade_meals status
habit_data = []
for note_meta in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_meta['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    content = note['content']
    # Find the line for ate_homemade_meals
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
            date_str = note_meta['title'].split('--')[1].strip()
            habit_data.append((date_str, value))
            break

# Sort by date
habit_data.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
print(habit_data)
